entities.name: The Archimandrite
entities.description: Leader of the Third Path who lived in the tallest Ivory Tower in Terisia City and named mana.

entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: Neutral alliance of mages and scholars in the war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Taught a meditative technique to the others.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother of Mishra in whose war the Third Path sought neutrality.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: Led Fallaji forces in the siege of Terisia City.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: Forces laying siege to Terisia City.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Group welcomed into the Order who betrayed the city.

entities.name: Fall of Terisia City
entities.description: Fall of the city after betrayal.

events.summary: Hurkyl, Drafna, Feldon, Chayum-Icha, Kathwar and others meet with the Archimandrite to establish the Third Path as a neutral alliance.
events.quote: to establish the Third Path , also known as the "Union".

events.summary: The Archimandrite shows aptitude at Hurkyl's meditative technique and names the energies "mana".
events.quote: The Archimandrite showed great aptitude at this

events.summary: Mishra decides to eradicate Terisia City; Hajar's Fallaji besiege it for months.
events.quote: Mishra decided to eradicate Terisia City.

events.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix betrays the city and opens the gates, leading to its fall.
events.quote: They finally betrayed the city and opened the gates to the onslaught

events.summary: The Archimandrite participates in the defense and possibly falls with the city.
events.quote: The Archimandrite participated in the defense of the city and possibly fell along with it

relations.quote: The Archimandrite was one of the leaders of the Third Path
They finally betrayed the city and opened the gates to the onslaught
